beats.say: Now the defence. One. Buffett admitted that in the past, American Express was even mismanaged. Two. It tried expanding into unrelated businesses, with little success. Three. beats.say: So, here's our verdict. The American Express moat is trust. A name that strangers accept almost like money. The salad oil scandal was a bad wound, in a side unit, that never reached that heart. And its status? Sixty years after the scandal, Berkshire is still its biggest shareholder.
